caption: The 18% → 12% change first edits the invoice test's expected values, then reruns the 12 impact-selected tests with the GST invoice first. The 80-test suite and the 500-test retest-all are escalations, not the default — the 12-test run is 41.7 times smaller than retest-all.

spec.title: Rerun plan for the GST change
spec.aria: Flow for the GST rate change: the deliberate 18% to 12% change updates the invoice test's expected tax from ₹180 to ₹120 and total from ₹1,180 to ₹1,120, then the 12 impact-selected tests rerun with the GST invoice first, escalating to the 80-test suite if time allows and to retest-all of 500 only as a fallback.
